simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָסַךְ (H5259) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: נָסַךְ (nâçak) means to interweave , i.e. (figuratively) to overspread First listed occurrence: Isa 25 7.

definitions.full: H5259. nasak II. [ נָסַךְ ] verb weave (Arabic has same meaning); — Qal Passive participle feminine נְסוּכָה Isa 25:7 ; perhaps also Infinitive construct לִנְסֹךְ 30:1 ; on both see following
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (probably identical with 5258 through the idea of fusion);
